title: Web session
description: The signed-in Human of a Conn Lab browser session and the session's CSRF token (decision 0013). The session token itself never appears in a response body; it lives only in the HttpOnly __Host-conn_web cookie.

csrf_token.description: Sent back as the X-Conn-CSRF header on every unsafe request. Unpadded base64url of 32 bytes derived from the session token.
